title: A session that asked again for a granted tool whose MCP server is down is told the cause and the next step: reconnect or reload for a failed server; for one waiting for a login — that the hub knows, go on without it (no login of its own); it does not loop on the request
note: bin/hub of one version (main), only the input differs. failed-server: before — `already has it` (main), after — the PR's refusal. waiting-for-login: before — the PR's first commit (run `hub mcp login`), after — its second (the hub has been told; go on without the tool). The refusal reaches the session as the output of its own `hub tools request`; the eval cannot run the core, so the turn's input carries that output. `hub mcp …` is recorded, not run. Names and texts are made up.
